title: Happy sloth
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <rect x='0' y='68' width='100' height='5' rx='2.5' fill='#a87440'/>

  <circle cx='57' cy='38' r='2.6' fill='#ffe27a'/>
  <circle cx='43.8' cy='38.6' r='1.1' fill='#3a2a1a'/>
  <circle cx='57.8' cy='38.6' r='1.1' fill='#3a2a1a'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='44' rx='3.2' ry='2.4' fill='#5a3a22'/>
  <!-- happy smile -->
  <path d='M45 48 Q50 52 55 48' fill='none' stroke='#5a3a22' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='31' cy='36' r='4' fill='#b08a5a'/>
  <circle cx='69' cy='36' r='4' fill='#b08a5a'/>
  <!-- leaves -->
  <path d='M84 62 Q92 52 96 60 Q90 66 84 62 Z' fill='#5fae4a'/>
  <path d='M12 62 Q4 54 2 62 Q8 66 12 62 Z' fill='#77c95f'/>
